module: Manages the multi-seat session (split screen) in freeroam: choice of suggested vehicles, spawn plan (level positions, otherwise a group of nearby parking spots, otherwise road), opening the multiseat settings, enabling/disabling split screen and traffic, exit to solo mode, and restoration after a UI or Lua reload. A level can provide mainLevel.getMultiseatSuggestedVehicles(playerCount) and mainLevel.getMultiseatSpawnPositions(playerCount), or multiseat.suggestedVehicles in info.json.
notes: The positions returned by mainLevel.getMultiseatSpawnPositions can be {parkingSpot}, a parking object (with moveResetVehicleTo) or {pos, rot}; at least one per player is required, otherwise the fallback plan (parking) is used.

The parking plan looks for a group of free standard-size spots within a 30 m radius (PARKING_CLUSTER_RADIUS) large enough for all players; otherwise the vehicles are placed on the road via reconcileFreeroamVehicles.
Reason codes returned by startSplitscreenFreeroam: no_players, vehicle_assignment_failed, vehicle_spawn_failed.
onSerialize returns {restoreAsFreeroam = true} only if the session (or a gamemode) is active; onUiReady then restores the multiseat setting, the split screen and the "multiseat" UI route.
exitMultiseat keeps player 0's vehicle, deletes the others, disables multiseat (settings multiseat = false) and unloads render_splitScreen and gameplay_traffic_source.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before: gameplay_city, gameplay_parking, gameplay_traffic, ui_multiseat_multiseatSettings, ui_multiseat_multiseatVehicles.

activate.desc: Loads gameplay_multiseat_gamemodeManager and marks the multiseat freeroam session as active.

deactivate.desc: Marks the session as inactive and cancels any pending restoration.

isActive.desc: Returns whether the multiseat freeroam session is active.

restoreAfterReload.desc: Marks the session active and queues a restoration, executed at the next onUiReady.

startSplitscreenFreeroam.desc: Starts freeroam in split screen: assigns each registered player a vehicle suggested for the level, builds a spawn plan (level, then parking, otherwise road), spawns the vehicles and activates the session on success. If spawning fails, the vehicles are removed.

levelName.desc: Level name, used to find the suggested vehicles.

openSettings.desc: Starts a multiseat configuration (source "settings") and navigates to the route "pause.multiseatSettings". If navigation fails, the configuration is abandoned.

returns.desc: false if navigation failed, otherwise true.

onMultiseatSettingsApplied.desc: Hook called when the multiseat settings have been applied. Activates the session; with more than one player, loads render_splitScreen, gives it the players and adds the players to the traffic sources; with a single player, unloads split screen and traffic. Then closes the menu. No effect if result.success == false or result.exitAfterApply == true.

exitMultiseat.desc: Returns to solo freeroam: stops the multiseat gamemode, optionally applies an assignment cache (options.assignmentCache), stops drag races and a non-mission crawl, deletes all vehicles except player 0's, clears the session, turns off multiseat and gives the vehicle back to player 0 with the game camera.

options.desc: Options; assignmentCache = player assignments to cache before exiting.

returns.desc: false if the session was not active or the cache could not be saved, otherwise true.

onMultiseatSettingsClosed.desc: Hook called when the multiseat settings are closed; does nothing here.

onPauseHomeRailBuildMultiseatActions.desc: Pause menu home rail hook: adds the buttons "home.changeMultiseatSettings" (opens pause.multiseatSettings) and "home.exitMultiseat" (confirmation, then exitMultiseat and return to "play"). Nothing is added if neither the session nor a multiseat gamemode is active.

registerButton.desc: Function that registers a button and its callback.

onSerialize.desc: Hook called before a Lua reload; returns {restoreAsFreeroam = true} if a session is active, otherwise nothing.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after a Lua reload; if the restoreAsFreeroam marker is present, calls restoreAfterReload.

onUiReady.desc: Hook called when the UI is ready; if a restoration is pending, restores multiseat, the split screen, the traffic and reloads the "multiseat" UI route (set as the game route).

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of the level; deactivates the session and cancels any restoration.
